q.line: We must plunge, we must plunge, we must plunge
stanza: We must hang up in the belfry where the bats and moonlight laugh
We must stare into a crystal ball and only see the past
Into the caverns of tomorrow with just our flashlights and our love
We must plunge, we must plunge, we must plunge

partner.line: Into the caverns of tomorrow with just our flashlights and our love
